Record model count, overlap window, and runner selection for compute-bound tasks, selecting DualGPURunner only when multiple models are loaded concurrently.
Retain the existing doomed-rerun pre-launch block as saved-time instrumentation and keep those sub-second blocks out of slow-task rankings.

meta_reflection: The milestone's delay was concentrated in one synthesis-only workflow rather than in visible compute execution.
